topicName: Subscriptions, Management Groups, and Enterprise Scale Landing Zones
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Enterprise-Scale Azure Architecture: Subscriptions, Management Groups, and Landing Zones"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Designing a secure, scalable, and manageable cloud environment in Microsoft Azure requires a solid foundation built on Management Groups, Subscriptions, and Enterprise-Scale Landing Zones. This tutorial covers the core architectural concepts and provides practical implementation steps using Azure CLI."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Understanding the Azure Hierarchy"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"The Azure resource hierarchy consists of four critical levels: Management Groups, Subscriptions, Resource Groups, and Resources. Management Groups provide governance scope above subscriptions. Subscriptions serve as a billing boundary and a security boundary for policies and role-based access control (RBAC)."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Management Groups: Organize subscriptions into hierarchical structures for centralized policy and compliance management."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Subscriptions: Act as a logical container for resource groups and services, tied closely to billing and service limits."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Resource Groups: Logical containers for specific Azure resources needed for a particular solution."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Implementing Enterprise-Scale Landing Zones (CAF)"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) Enterprise-Scale defines the architectural blueprint for large-scale migrations. It typically incorporates a root management group, followed by child management groups for Platform (Connectivity, Identity, Management), Landing Zones (Corp, Online), and Sandbox environments."},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"3. Creating the Management Group Hierarchy via Azure CLI"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Below is an example script using Azure CLI to create a standardized management group structure aligned with Enterprise-Scale recommendations."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"az account clear
az login

# Create Root Enterprise Management Group
az account management-group create --name "Contoso-Root" --title "Contoso Root Group"

# Create Platform Management Group
az account management-group create --name "Contoso-Platform" --title "Platform" --parent "Contoso-Root"

# Create Landing Zones Management Group
az account management-group create --name "Contoso-LandingZones" --title "Landing Zones" --parent "Contoso-Root"

# Create Sandbox Management Group
az account management-group create --name "Contoso-Sandbox" --title "Sandbox" --parent "Contoso-Root""},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"4. Moving Subscriptions to Landing Zones"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"Once subscriptions are provisioned, they must be moved into their designated management groups to inherit the correct Azure policies and RBAC roles."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"# Move a subscription to the Landing Zones management group
az account management-group subscription add --name "Contoso-LandingZones" --subscription "<YOUR-SUBSCRIPTION-ID>""},{"order":16,"type":"subheading","text":"5. Best Practices and Governance"},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Apply Azure Policy at the highest management group level practical (e.g., denying public IP creation or enforcing region restrictions)."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use Azure Blueprints or Terraform to automate the deployment of the entire landing zone hierarchy."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Maintain a dedicated Identity and Access Management (IAM) strategy utilizing Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) Privileged Identity Management (PIM)."},{"order":20,"type":"paragraph","text":"By following this structured approach to Subscriptions, Management Groups, and Enterprise-Scale Landing Zones, your organization will achieve robust governance, seamless scalability, and operational excellence in Azure."}]
